title: Standard Parts and Supply Chain
description: Standard Parts and Supply Chain as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are standard parts and catalogue items expected to be used identified?
Are bought-in equipment items and candidate suppliers identified?
Are standard parts selected from the approved catalogue?
Are bought-in items allocated project control numbers?
Are supply risks recorded for single-source or long-lead items?
Are all standard parts and catalogue items called up by their catalogue designations?
Are bought-in item specifications and supplier part numbers recorded?
Are alternate standard parts recorded where approved?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
